name: MODP_LATENTSUB
description: Variant of MODP where P_D (a-b) and its identity face f_sub are structurally latent: neither is ever placed in the training stream (TRAIN_P_D.jsonl / TRAIN_f_sub.jsonl are not written). P_D is only reachable, if at all, by composing the taught edges P_Pn (a,b)->(a,-b) and Pn_D (a,-b)->a-b; f_sub can only be answered by combining that composition with the taught f_comm/f_div-style equality skill. This is the RCN12-style 'latent composition' test layered on top of the grokking design: the ground-truth Betti sequence shows a genuine open-then-closed cycle (taught_no_faces[1,2] -> +P_D edge only [1,1], a NEW independent 1-cycle opens -> +P_D+f_sub [1,0], the cycle closes) even though every cell in it was declared before training started.
